summary: Complete initial source-scope chronology audit of all 132 Chinese units, 20 temporal or active-hint items, and 10 people. This military treatise uses ruler, dynasty, and institutional contexts, including reign-wide ranges attached to offices and title-holders. Every temporal record is retained as a source-qualified research hold until independent source-critical confirmation can distinguish a dated institutional reference from personal life or activity chronology. No source or extraction data is changed.
